t: Understanding MIFOR: Mumbai Interbank Forward Offer Rate Explained
s: December 9, 2025 - The term Mumbai Interbank Forward Offer Rate (MIFOR) refers to a benchmark rate used by commercial banks for certain financial contracts in India. MIFOR was used for setting prices on forward-rate agreements and derivatives. It was a mix of the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR) and a forward premium derived from Indian foreign exchange markets.

t: What is MIFOR Full Form: Its Characteristics | NoBroker Forum
s: July 7, 2022 - A standard rate used by the commercial banks of India for specific financial agreements is referred to as the Mumbai Interbank Forward Offer Rate (MIFOR). Rates for contracts and forward-rate arrangements are set using MIFOR. A forward charge earned from Indian foreign exchange markets is combined with the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR).
